THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964

Notice under Section 7 My No: MO/TW/LND/08/06. Land Min's Ref. No.: 4-3/5/2013/HW/566. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for the reconstruction of bridge No. 41/1 on the Bodagama-Hambegamuwa-Kalthota Road. Description of the land to be acquired: Schedule I All allotments of land depicted in Sheet No. 02, Zone II of the Plan No. C.M. 720289, situated at the Village of Kotaweheramankada in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 149 C Kotaweheramankada in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Thanamalwila of Monaragala District in the Uva Province and further described as follows; Lot No. 102 Name of the Land: Kotaweheramankada Kele; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0037 Hectare.

Lot No. 103 Name of the Land: Kotaweheramankada Kele; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0250 Hectare. Lot No. 104 Name of the Land: Kotaweheramankada Kele; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0013 Hectare. Lot No. 105 Name of the Land: -; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0034 Hectare. Lot No. 107 Name of the Land: -; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0088 Hectare. Schedule 2 All allotments of land depicted in Sheet No. 60 of the Interim Plan No. 62, F.T.P. 67, situated at the Village of Kotaweheramankada in the Minor Division of Kongala Binthenna Korale of the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Thanamalwila of Monaragala District in the Uva Province and further described as follows; Lot No. 1562 Name of the Land: Kotaweheramankada Kele; Claimant: Government; Extent: 230.0596 Hectares.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Thanamalwila, on the 20th of March, 2025 at 10.30 a.m. and hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 21st of February, 2025, the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
